company.name: Mauj
company.shortDescription: Mauj is a sexual and menstrual wellness company.
company.description:
Mauj is a sexual and menstrual wellness company. Mauj is driven by a common goal to challenge the stigma and misinformation surrounding female sexuality in their region. Mauj is a pioneering sexual and menstrual wellness platform created by and for Arab women, focused on breaking the stigma surrounding women’s bodies, sexuality, and reproductive health in the Arab world. Founded by two Arab women who experienced firsthand the shame, misinformation, and silence around these topics, Mauj aims to create a safe, inclusive, and educational space where women can learn about their bodies without fear or judgment.
The platform offers culturally conscious, bilingual, and sex-positive educational content covering topics such as menstrual health, consent, relationships, pleasure, and reproductive wellness. Through social media campaigns, community storytelling initiatives, expert collaborations, and wellness products, Mauj seeks to normalize open conversations around female health and empowerment.
